caption: Habsburg Castle, Habsburg
composition: Rear castle of Habsburg on the wooded Wülpelsberg · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the wooded Wülpelsberg in the municipality of Habsburg, the rear castle still stands as a large crenellated tower, a smaller tower, and the 13th-century residence. The front castle remains a low conserved ruin, and the frame keeps that ruin low. This is the compact ancestral seat in Aargau. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and breezy, with no rain.
